attempts.text:
Two cars can rescue 22 people for 180 driving minutes. The 3 adults at Bidur farm and Trishuli farm are unreachable: their only connection goes through Tarkeshwar care home, and the road to Suryagadhi temple is damaged. Deferring those 3 adults costs 60, so the total is 240.

Car1 (from Myagang) clears Kalika village, Suryagadhi temple, Dhunche school and Galchhi school. Car2 (from Uttargaya) clears Shivapuri farm and Gosaikunda school.
